SaveGamePort<TState>.reason: external persistence boundary and backward compatibility

DomainSaveGamePort.reason: canonical Layer 2 runtime save state after Stage 63

rules: Deterministic RNG remains pure domain and is not hidden behind a port.
Domain events remain data; event publication is outside Layer 2.
Snapshot capture/restore remains in-memory domain logic; persistence uses SaveGamePort.
No port exposes renderer, physics, DOM, Tauri, Steamworks, filesystem or engine internals.
Existing SaveLoadUseCase and ModdingAppService contracts remain backward compatible.
Stage 66 global portability gate is not anticipated.
